name: rerail/port-readiness-upstream-bladestan
description: Bladestan as the conformance gates run it: the release the Blade pack's ported rules name, the PHPStan it runs, and the development dependencies its own rule test (tests/Rules/BladeRuleTest.php) runs with. Orchestra Testbench's core is the application the test boots, and nikic/php-parser the parser Bladestan compiles templates with, so both are pinned too.
